The stale 2023 map MISSED 12 bins / 526.1 MW in 2024 and 26 bins / 3,692.3 MW in 2025 whose outage events never reached the LP at all -- the largest term physical and legible, plant 6193 filed (6193,'COAL') 1,018.0 MW in the 2023 vintage and (6193,'ST_GAS') 1,018.0 MW in the true 2025 fleet, a coal-to-gas conversion, so a span routed its 2025 events to a bin the stale map did not have.
